name: Bonaria
text: my parcel has been at the depot six days and the tracking hasnt moved since tuesday, a call to support got me nowhere but Bonaria promised a trace

name: Umukoro
text: the replacement kettle arrived with a cracked lid and the returns portal kept timing out, i finally got through on the phone, so the old one can go back, and Umukoro agreed to send a pickup label

name: Meteor Garaboa
text: the smart meter stopped sending readings three weeks ago and the estimated bills are double what we use, i have sent photos of the display twice and called once, an engineer visit is now booked to swap the unit, the advisor who sorted it was Meteor Garaboa

name: de Fontana
text: the online account keeps logging me out mid payment and i lost a basket twice, after a long chat my profile was finally reset, the agent was de Fontana

name: Martinho
text: my broadband has been dropping every evening for a week and the router lights go red, a full reset did nothing so i rang support and waited twenty minutes for an answer, the person who sorted it was Martinho

name: Vijayabalan
text: the insurance claim for the cracked windscreen was stuck in review for two weeks and every call ended with give it more time, i emailed the photos again on monday, by wednesday the approval came through and the repair is booked, the claim handler Vijayabalan apologised for the delay

name: Vegard Nelvin
text: the app crashes every time i try to upload id for verification and theres no way round it, a bug ticket got raised for me by Vegard Nelvin

name: Cándida Ucci
text: the hotel booking was cancelled by the venue and the refund hasnt landed after ten days, i sent the confirmation again and called the billing line twice, it was Cándida Ucci who finally pushed the refund through today

name: Djiby
text: the gas safety certificate was uploaded to the wrong account and the letting agent couldnt see it for a month, i spent an hour on hold twice and sent three emails with no reply, the records were merged by a supervisor named Djiby and the certificate is now attached correctly

name: Borko
text: the key fob stopped working at the side gate and the intercom just buzzes without opening, after a call out the fix was done by Borko from maintenance

name: de Koster
text: the washing machine warranty claim was rejected because the serial number was typed wrong, i sent a close up of the plate and the receipt, the case was reopened by de Koster and the repair went back on

name: Guled Grayson
text: the standing order for the gym membership kept failing even though the funds were there and the bank blamed the gym, i took statements into the branch and the manager called the payments team, it was a stale card token and a fresh mandate was set up by Guled Grayson

name: Abbrederis
text: the new debit card never turned up and the old one expires friday, the phone queue got me nowhere, a replacement went out special delivery after Abbrederis chased the courier

name: Janie
text: Hi team. The courier slot for the pump collection is booked for Thursday between nine and noon. The crate by the loading door needs to be out from eight. Any change, shout before Wednesday, Janie will confirm once the van is on its way.

name: Lucantonio
text: Hello all, the head office audit visit has moved to the 18th and the space is already booked for that morning. We are pencilling in the small meeting room instead, so the session may need splitting. The key is with reception. Please hold off printing until the room is confirmed, the revised agenda will go round from Lucantonio.

name: Ihyane Zarate
text: Hi there, the meter reading for unit four came in high again so i have asked for a recheck on the display, Ihyane Zarate will email the result

name: Chyara Cornélia
text: Hi both, the fete poster is at the printers and we should have the proofs by Monday. If the colours look off we have time for one more round before the run. Chyara Cornélia will collect the box on Tuesday.

name: Ejup
text: Hi everyone, the minibus for the away match leaves at half six sharp from the sports centre and the list is now full. Bring a pound for the driver fund and check the kit bag on Friday. The seating plan goes in the group tonight so nobody swaps without telling Ejup.

name: Mönkhoff
text: Hi, the spare keys for the store cupboard are back on the hook and door code has been changed, the new one will go to the duty phone from Mönkhoff

name: Matteus Merlijn
text: Hi all, the choir bus for the festival leaves from the church gate at seven and returns after the evening set. Seats are allocated so please keep to the list. Matteus Merlijn will collect the music folders before we board.

name: Nawar Marylisa
text: Hello team, the samples for the spring range came back from the lab with one odd result and the supplier is asking questions. The paperwork looks fine. A retest has been ordered and the draft reply will go out once it clears, so please do not email the supplier yet, this one is with Nawar Marylisa.

name: Mamerto
text: Hi all, the window cleaner is coming Friday instead of Thursday so please move the planters off the sills, the gate code will be left with the cafe by Mamerto

name: Boecker
text: Hi everyone, the roof survey is booked for Tuesday morning and the van will need the front bays kept clear. The surveyor wants access to the stairwell, so the boxes stored there should move to the back office. Boecker will put labels up tonight.

name: El Manaa
text: Dear residents, the lift maintenance window has been extended to Friday afternoon and the stairs remain the only way up until then. Please keep the stairwell clear. The contractor has been asked to avoid the school run hours. El Manaa will post any change on the noticeboard and in the group chat.

name: Patric Allah
text: Hi team, the meeting room clock is ten minutes fast so ignore it for the client call, the fix is down to Patric Allah after lunch

name: Özen
text: Hi all, the drain outside the kitchen door is backing up again so the cleaner has been asked to skip that corner. The plumber can only come Thursday at noon. Özen will meet him there and unlock the yard.

name: Anjeli
text:
my phone trade in was valued online at a fair price but the pickup never got booked and the quote is about to expire, i have chatted twice and called once with no luck, if you can still honour the original quote that would be great, thanks,
Anjeli

name: Kumbar
text:
the pickup has been rescheduled three times now and no one rings ahead, tomorrow is the last day i can be in, thanks,
Kumbar

name: Alemin Elemér
text:
i ordered two lamps and only one arrived but the invoice lists both, the box was taped up fine so it happened before packing, i need the second lamp or a refund of half the order, regards,
Alemin Elemér

name: Hassane Hedy
text:
the annual service plan fell through when my saved card ran out in march even though i updated it twice, now the policy shows as lapsed and the app wont let me renew, could someone check the payment details on your side and take the payment manually if needed, thanks,
Hassane Hedy

name: Shihan
text:
my locker key snapped in the lock and the spare at home is for a different door, can maintenance come up tonight, best,
Shihan

name: Dobrivoe
text:
the shower drain has been slow for a week and now the tray fills up during a normal shower, i have tried the usual unblocker with no luck, please send someone before the weekend, cheers,
Dobrivoe

name: Calapes Biscontin
text:
my account was locked after i mistyped the password twice and the reset email never arrives, i have checked spam and tried a different browser, the phone line cuts off before anyone answers so email is my only option, please unlock the account or send a working link, thanks,
Calapes Biscontin

name: Mc Kenzie
text:
the gate remote only works from a metre away and the battery is new, can you pair the spare one instead, thanks,
Mc Kenzie

name: Laurentiu-Florin
text:
my direct debit came out twice this month and the second charge left me short, i have the bank statement ready if you need proof, please refund the duplicate asap, regards,
Laurentiu-Florin

name: Gisler-Zurfluh
text:
the booking for the pool lane hire was changed to a smaller slot without anyone telling us and the price stayed the same, we have ten swimmers confirmed for saturday and the new slot only fits six, please move us back or refund the difference, thanks,
Gisler-Zurfluh

name: Khatibi Sherabtsang Rajabenjamin
text:
the heating in flat 12 is stuck on full and the valve handle has come off in my hand, please send someone today, thanks,
Khatibi Sherabtsang Rajabenjamin

name: Germar Bismillah
text:
the washing machine in the launderette swallowed two pounds and never started, the display just flashes e4, i have a photo of the error if you want it, cheers,
Germar Bismillah

name: Cabdinasir
text:
Hi team, the stocktake count for aisle four is done and the variance list is attached. Two lines are over by a full case, which the weekend crew flagged as a mis-scan, and the rest match to the unit. If nobody objects I will post the adjustments tonight. Thanks,
Cabdinasir

name: Scavelli
text:
Hi, the courier left the parcel with the flat next door and nobody told me. I found it at six. Please update the delivery notes for flat 3b. Regards,
Scavelli

name: El Wirfali
text:
Hi all, the training room booking for Thursday has been moved to the library meeting space because the projector is being replaced. The start time stays at ten and the link will work the same. If you are joining online nothing changes. Regards,
El Wirfali

name: Del Papa Contractor
text:
Hello, the quote for the office move came in higher than the budget we agreed in the meeting. The extra is mostly the piano and the glass cabinets, which need crating. If we move those ourselves the total lands right. Can you confirm by Friday so we keep the slot? Best,
Del Papa Contractor

name: Altin
text:
Hi, the spare projector bulb is in the cupboard above the kettle. I have labelled the box so it is easy to spot. Cheers,
Altin

name: Lomuto
text:
Hi both, the bird survey volunteers have confirmed for Saturday and the spare binoculars are in the ranger hut. We need to be on the meadow by half five, so bring a flask. The gate key will be under the usual stone. Thanks,
Lomuto

name: Szir Nüsslein
text:
Hi everyone, the summer party deposit has cleared and the venue is confirmed for the 22nd. The menu choices need to be in by the end of next week and the dietary notes go straight to the caterer. We still need two volunteers for the welcome table. Please add your name to the sheet. Best,
Szir Nüsslein

name: Calin Gondini
text:
Hi, the workshop door is jamming again so please use the side entrance until it is planed back. I have left a sign up. Regards,
Calin Gondini

name: Sintayehu
text:
Hi all, the rota for the spring fair is nearly full and I still need one more face painter for the afternoon shift. Everything is in the shared folder, including the stall layout and the float instructions. Reply if you can cover it. Cheers,
Sintayehu

name: Medjitna
text:
Hi both, the archive boxes for the old contracts are ready for collection and the list is taped to the top one. The records team wants them by the end of the month, so the van is booked for Thursday morning. Please sign the sheet when they go and leave a copy in the cabinet. Thanks,
Medjitna

name: Alinovi Galerne Hegardt
text:
Hi, the sample jars for the pond survey are washed and on the drying rack. Please label them before Friday. Thanks,
Alinovi Galerne Hegardt

name: Helias Magaz
text:
Hi team, the quiet carriage booking for the conference trip is confirmed for coach c and the seats are grouped. Bring your own headphones because the trolley service is limited on that route. The meeting point is platform two at half seven. Regards,
Helias Magaz
